name: Minakami Ren
source:
Specialty: Abacus, making sweets
Hobby: Origami, sketching
Likes: Siberia
Dislikes: Omiai

A girl raised in a downtown area who attends an all-girls school in Asakusa. Although she has a well-behaved personality, she is overflowed by curiosity in romance and opposite sex due to the current trends. Since she has no knowledge about foreign countries like Chief or Tooko, the presence of Tsukasa who came from the modern day extremely excites Ren.

"Oh, no... how disgraceful I am, wanting to see a boy's nether region."
